title: Count the peaks
prompt:
A cell is a **peak** if its value is strictly greater than the **average of its existing neighbors** (the in-bounds 8 neighbors — corners have 3, edges have 5; the cell itself never counts). Count the peaks. Implement `process(int[][] g)`.

Example: `{{9,1},{1,1}}` → `1`.

tests.name: peak count
tests.hint: Reuse the neighbor pattern but ALSO count the in-bounds neighbors; divide the sum by that count (as a double).
